act.long_title: An Act to provide legal recognition for transactions carried out by means of electronic data interchange and other means of electronic communication, commonly referred to as
act.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Validity of contracts formed through electronic means
section.html: 1 [10A. Validity of contracts formed through electronic means.--Where in a contract formation, the communication of proposals, the acceptance of proposals, the revocation of proposals and acceptances, as the case may be, are expressed in electronic form or by means of an electronic records, such contract shall not be deemed to be unenforceable solely on the ground that such electronic form or means was used for that purpose.]
